headline: Fierce Northern Battles Rage Across Stlican Shelf and Weathered Expanse
war_summary: Since the previous dispatch, frontline combat has concentrated sharply along the northern corridor, with Stlican Shelf, Nevish Line, and Weathered Expanse recording persistent base transfers through the past two hours. Weathered Expanse endures as the conflict's deadliest theater, posting heavy accelerating casualties as fighting swirls across Crow's Nest and Frostmarch. Along the Stlican Shelf, six base actions within the last two hours have contested Fort Hoarfrost and Breaker Town, leaving two strongholds reduced to unoccupied ground. Nevish Line also saw immediate combat turnover near Blackcoat Way, keeping the sector tightly divided. While Callahan's Passage registered no structural captures in the last two hours, casualty rates there have accelerated dramatically under sustained bombardments. To the west, Mooring County reports a sudden surge in combat enlistments and losses, whereas Stonecradle and Linn of Mercy have settled into relative quiet following earlier morning upheavals. The southern and interior regions remain entirely subdued.
